sar.narrative: Between 2016-12-11 and 2016-12-11, card C09988-K1 held by customer C09988 was used for 1 transaction(s) totaling $59.67 that the bank assesses as unauthorized. The transactions were: 3534820 ($59.67, 2016-12-11 22:39, online, product C). The activity was identified through a customer report on transaction 3534820 opened 2016-12-12 01:39:08. The activity shows Device profile 'Windows | edge 16.0' is new to this account and transacted on 70 other customers' cards within a month; 10 closed cases on this profile were confirmed fraud. One actor using one device across many cardholders — a shared-device ring that none of the five documented patterns describes.. The same device profile (Windows | edge 16.0) was used on the cards of 70 other customers within the same month, including cards not individually identified, and appears on confirmed-fraud closed cases CC-0497, CC-2540, CC-2675, CC-2694. The cardholder reported that they did not make the purchase(s) and remains in possession of the card; identity was confirmed through the bank's verification step. Channel: online; billing region code(s): not recorded. The activity is suspicious because it departs from the cardholder's established history (median transaction $37.75) and matches a coordinated scheme across multiple cardholders. The card has been recommended for blocking and reissue and a case has been opened; connected cards are under monitoring where applicable.
